original_prompt: Write a Helm chart deploying a Java Spring Boot application with a separate config Secret (Spring profile), readiness and liveness probes targeting /actuator/health, and an Ingress with TLS.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments)

Task: Write a Helm chart deploying a Java Spring Boot application with a separate config Secret (Spring profile), readiness and liveness probes targeting /actuator/health, and an Ingress with TLS.

Output only the Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
# FILE: Chart.yaml
name: spring-boot-app
version: 1.0.0
description: A Helm chart for deploying a Java Spring Boot application
type: application

---
# FILE: values.yaml
replicaCount: 1
image:
  repository: spring-boot-app
  tag: latest
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
service:
  type: ClusterIP
  port: 8080
ingress:
  enabled: true
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-redirect: "true"
  hosts:
    - host: spring-boot-app.local
      paths:
        - "/"
  tls:
    - hosts:
        - spring-boot-app.local
      secretName: spring-boot-app-tls
config:
  spring:
    profile: dev

---
# FILE: templates/deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ include "spring-boot-app.fullname" . }}
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicaCount }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      {{- include "spring-boot-app.labels" . | nindent 6 }}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        {{- include "spring-boot-app.labels" . | nindent 8 }}
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: {{ .Chart.Name }}
          image: "{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}"
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.pullPolicy }}
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
              protocol: TCP
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /actuator/health
              port: http
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /actuator/health
              port: http
          env:
            - name: SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE
              value: {{ .Values.config.spring.profile }}
          volumeMounts:
            - name: config
              mountPath: /config
              readOnly: true
      volumes:
        - name: config
          secret:
            secretName: {{ include "spring-boot-app.fullname" . }}-config

---
# FILE: templates/service.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ include "spring-boot-app.fullname" . }}
spec:
  type: {{ .Values.service.type }}
  ports:
    - port: {{ .Values.service.port }}
      targetPort: http
      protocol: TCP
      name: http
  selector:
    {{- include "spring-boot-app.labels" . | nindent 4 }}

---
# FILE: templates/ingress.yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: {{ include "spring-boot-app.fullname" . }}
  annotations:
    {{- toYaml .Values.ingress.annotations | trim | nindent 4 }}
spec:
  tls:
    {{- toYaml .Values.ingress.tls | trim | nindent 4 }}
  rules:
    {{- range .Values.ingress.hosts }}
    - host: {{ .host }}
      http:
        paths:
          {{- range .paths }}
          - path: {{ . }}
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: {{ include "spring-boot-app.fullname" . }}
                port:
                  name: http
          {{- end }}
    {{- end }}

---
# FILE: templates/secret.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: {{ include "spring-boot-app.fullname" . }}-config
type: Opaque
data:
  application.properties: {{ .Values.config | toYaml | b64enc | quote }}

---
# FILE: templates/_helpers.tpl
{{- define "spring-boot-app.fullname" -}}
{{- printf "%s-%s" .Chart.Name .Release.Name | replace "+" "_" | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" -}}
{{- end -}}

{{- define "spring-boot-app.labels" -}}
app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "spring-boot-app.fullname" . }}
app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
{{- end -}}
